Lemon Tart Bars with Gingersnap Crust
adapted from The Bohemian Vegan cookbook
Serves 6-10

Crust:
14 gingersnap cookies

Filling:
1 cup freshly squeezed lemon juice, divided
1 cup coconut oil (or melted butter; I used 1/2 coconut oil and 1/2 vegetable oil)
1 14-ounce can coconut milk
1 cup cane or white sugar, divided
4 whole eggs
1/4 cup all-purpose flour

Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Spray a 9x13 inch casserole with cooking spray or butter baking dish. Place the cookies in a sealable bag and crush them into crumbs, either with a rolling pin or in the food processor. Press the cookie crumbs into the bottom of the baking pan and set aside.

Pour 1/2 cup of the lemon juice into a bowl. In a medium saucepan, heat the coconut oil, coconut milk, and the remaining 1/2 cup of lemon juice over medium heat until the coconut oil softens and the mixture is well stirred. Slowly whisk in 1/2 cup of sugar as the mixture heats. When the sugar is fully mixed in, add the eggs one at a time and whisk until the eggs are airated. Sprinkle in the flour and whisk for about a minute while the mixture gets thicker. Turn off the heat and pour the mixture into the baking pan. Cook the tart for about an hour or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. The center may seem jiggly, so make sure you pick a spot away from the sides that has a firm edge.

Remove from the oven and cool slightly. Sift the remaining sugar over the top and return the pan to the oven, leaving the door ajar so the mixture doesn't bake or harden. Cook for an additional 10 minutes, then remove from the oven
